nodes.label: Notas de Caso - Note Creation Form UI (Captio)
nodes.author: toledolaw
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the 'Notas de caso' (Case Notes) page in the Captio legal case management app. Shows a note creation/editing form for case #4 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' in the Negocios/contrato category. The form contains: a Título (Title) field filled with 'Especificaciones de contratos', a Notas padre (Parent Notes) section with a tag 'Notas de la primera reunión con cliente' (hierarchical note linking), and a Nota (Note body) textarea with partial text 'Al revisar los contratos hemos encontrado inconsistencias en la redacción de...'. A 'Guardar nota' (Save note) button is at the bottom. The layout demonstrates hierarchical note organization, parent-child note relationships, and contextual note-taking within a case context. User 'toledolaw' is logged in (shown top right with green online indicator).
